description.value: Cafe C'est si bon is a French-inspired patisserie in West Vancouver specializing in elegant cakes and tarts, including a Basque cheesecake, Black Swan black-sesame cake, and a gluten-free Ispahan macaron dessert. Located in a unit at 1425 Marine Drive, the cafe operates a pre-order pickup model requiring orders three days in advance. A cyclist riding the Marine Drive corridor could swing by for a celebratory pastry, though advance planning is required.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (4 spaces, covered) at 76m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is an active French-inspired patisserie at 1425 Marine Drive Unit 240, West Vancouver, consistent with OSM tags. The site operates as a pre-order pickup model (FAQ states orders must be placed 3 days in advance), and lists specialty cakes and tarts with at least one gluten-free option (Ispahan). No cyclist-specific amenities — bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill — are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
